biggest_catch: This is a LOAN referral, not an account referral: your friend must sign for a qualifying loan or credit card balance of at least $5,000 (real estate loans, personal lines, and overdraft lines excluded; existing Advantage One loans can't be refinanced). Payment can take up to 90 days to post.
catches: Friend must open a qualifying loan or credit card with a minimum loan/balance amount of $5,000; both parties fill out the referral form.
Excludes real estate loans, personal lines, and overdraft lines of credit; existing Advantage One loans are ineligible for refinance.
Cannot be combined with any other offers, specials, or promotions.
Payment could take up to 90 days to post.
Advantage One can cancel the loan referral program at any time and disqualify referrals not made in good faith.

steps: Fill out the member referral form on myaocu.com and share it with your friend so both of you complete it.
Friend applies for and signs a qualifying loan or credit card with Advantage One with a minimum $5,000 loan/balance amount (subject to approval).
You and your friend each receive $50, with payment posting up to 90 days later.
timing: Payment could take up to 90 days to post after the friend signs for the qualifying loan.
